Class BrickGeneratorTest

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.bricks.BrickGeneratorTest
class BrickGeneratorTest extends Object
Unit tests for the BrickGenerator interface and RandomBrickGenerator implementation. Tests the 7-bag randomization system, fairness guarantees, and brick distribution.
Author:
Jacob Villegas
